nodes.title: Wave 7: protocol-side marketing contracts M01-M04 and the M05 consent link
nodes.spec:
Objective: once Wave 7 is open (docs/decisions/PROGRAM_ROADMAP_20260930.md §2 R-7: it opens when kix-commerce-apps node w6a-evidence is merged), write draft contracts for M01 membership (fan qualification issue, revoke, consent, proof; cards are not Wave 2 rights), M02 presale (eligibility, priority, purchase limit, link to booking hold), M03 coupons (issue, use, revoke, discount budget, order atomicity with B03 pricing), M04 referral (attribution, reward eligibility and amount; no payout) (TASK_005 lines ~85, 105; docs/status/ORIGINAL_32_STATUS.md M01-M05; docs/DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md §14). M05 CRM is a separate product; only the consent link (set_consent, authorize_marketing) is in scope.
Constraints: limits, discount rates and reward amounts are DECISION_REQUIRED · Astra; token-linked benefits (U5) stay on hold; no frontend trees here.
Acceptance: contract drafts under docs/contracts/; checks green.
Common rules: follow AGENTS.md (program mode) and docs/decisions/PROGRAM_ROADMAP_20260930.md. Keep the two locked kernel blobs (AGENTS.md §4) and reference/v0.3-rc1/** unchanged unless this node says otherwise. The locks and unlock conditions in docs/decisions/PROGRAM_DECISIONS_20260928.md §5 still hold: no real funds, real PG/bank/KYC calls, public endpoints, Sui testnet or mainnet, R2 or own replication/consensus/storage engine, and no new coin/TIX module (the only exception is the localnet package of node tl-2, and only after the User merges tl-coin-lock-adr following the Astra re-ruling). Do not invent SLOs or product policy values: product policy values and new protocol commands go to DECISION_REQUIRED · Astra; values that need legal, tax, accounting or provider answers stay UNDETERMINED with the owner named. Do not edit CI to make the task pass. Evidence per AGENTS.md §14; protocol and kernel checks green at the exact head.
